requirements.text: When the user drags a product item (li element) from the product list, the system should initiate a drag event, capturing the product's title and price for transfer. The product items are represented as 'li' elements with the attribute 'draggable' set to 'true'. Each product item contains an image, a title, and a price, identified by data-testid attributes such as 'product-item-1', 'product-title-1', and 'product-price-1'. The drag event should capture the title and price of the product being dragged.

The system should allow users to drag and drop product items(data-testid="product-item-1", data-testid="product-item-2", etc.) into a designated drop area (id="div1", data-testid="drop-area") to add them to the cart. Upon dropping, the cart display should automatically update: the product title appears in .box2, the unit price in .box3, and the quantity in .box1. The system supports adding both different and repeated products.

"The system calculates the total price by summing the prices of all products in the cart, formatting the total to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol (e.g., '$80.00'), and displays the total in the <div id="allMoney"> element."

generated_cases.title: Normal Drag Product Item
generated_cases.description: Verify that dragging a valid product item (li element with draggable='true') initiates a drag event and successfully captures the product's title and price for transfer.

generated_cases.title: Edge Drag Product Item with Special Characters
generated_cases.description: Verify that dragging a product item containing special characters in its title or price successfully initiates the drag event and correctly captures the data.

generated_cases.title: Boundary Drag First and Last List Items
generated_cases.description: Verify that dragging the absolute first and last product items in the product list correctly initiates drag events and captures their respective titles and prices.

generated_cases.title: Error Drag Item Without Draggable Attribute
generated_cases.description: Verify that attempting to drag an element that lacks the draggable='true' attribute does not initiate a valid product drag transfer event.

generated_cases.title: Drop single unique product into drop area
generated_cases.description: Verify that dropping a valid product item (e.g., data-testid='product-item-1') into the designated drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area') successfully adds it to the cart, updating .box1 with the quantity, .box2 with the product title, and .box3 with the unit price.

generated_cases.title: Drop repeated products to increment quantity
generated_cases.description: Verify that dropping the same product item multiple times into the drop area updates the cart display correctly, incrementing the quantity in .box1 while maintaining the title in .box2 and unit price in .box3.

generated_cases.title: Drop maximum supported items into drop area
generated_cases.description: Verify that dropping the maximum allowed distinct or total product items into the drop area correctly updates the cart display for all items without failing or missing data updates.

generated_cases.title: Attempt to drop non-product element into drop area
generated_cases.description: Verify that attempting to drop a non-product element that lacks proper product data into the designated drop area is rejected or ignored by the system, leaving the cart display unchanged.

generated_cases.title: Calculate total price for multiple distinct items (Normal)
generated_cases.description: Verify that the system correctly sums the prices of multiple distinct products in the cart, formats the total to two decimal places with the currency symbol, and displays it in <div id="allMoney">.

generated_cases.title: Calculate total price with zero items or single item (Edge)
generated_cases.description: Verify that the system correctly calculates and displays '$0.00' when the cart is empty, and correctly formats a single item's price with two decimal places and the currency symbol.

generated_cases.title: Handle large price values (Boundary)
generated_cases.description: Verify that the system correctly calculates and formats very large price sums without rounding errors or layout overflow in <div id="allMoney">.

generated_cases.title: Handle malformed price strings in cart items (Error/Abnormal)
generated_cases.description: Verify that the system gracefully handles or sanitizes malformed price strings in the cart without causing uncaught runtime exceptions during total price calculation.

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Dragging a product item initiates a drag event
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Drag and Drop Product Item
  The system should initiate a drag event when a user drags a product item from the product list, capturing the product's title and price for transfer.


  Scenario: [Normal] Dragging a product item initiates a drag event
    Given the webpage is loaded with a product list
    When the user drags the product item with data-testid "product-item-1"
    Then the drag event should be initiated
    And the product title "The Essence of JavaScript" should be captured
    And the product price "$40" should be captured

reference_cases.title: [Error] Attempting to drag a non-draggable element
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Drag and Drop Product Item

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Add a single product to the cart
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Add product to cart display when dropped into the drop area
  The system should add the product to the cart display, showing the product's title, price, and quantity when a product item is dropped into the drop area.


  Scenario: [Normal] Add a single product to the cart
    Given the webpage is loaded
    And the product item with data-testid "product-item-1" is visible
    When the user drags the product with data-testid "product-item-1" and drops it into the cart container with data-testid "drop-area"
    Then the cart display should show a product with title "The Essence of JavaScript"
    And the price "$40"
    And the quantity "1"

reference_cases.title: [Normal] Add a single product to the cart and verify total price
reference_cases.description:
Feature: Calculate and display the total price of products in the cart
  The system should calculate and display the total price of all products in the cart, updating the total each time a product is added.


  Scenario: [Normal] Add a single product to the cart and verify total price
    Given the webpage is loaded with a list of products
    When the user drags the product with data-testid "product-item-1" to the drop area with data-testid "drop-area"
    Then the total price displayed in the element with id "allMoney" should be "$40.00"
